scripts.repos:sync: for r in lineth-observability lineth-l2-gitops; do [ -d .repos/$r ] || git clone -q https://github.com/s1ns3nz0/$r.git .repos/$r; git -C .repos/$r pull -q --ff-only; done
scripts.lab:forward: export KUBECONFIG=$(mktemp); kind get kubeconfig --name lineth-local > $KUBECONFIG; trap 'kill 0' EXIT; for f in 'monitoring svc/monitoring-kube-prometheus-prometheus 9090:9090' 'logging svc/loki 3100:3100' 'kagent svc/kagent-controller 18083:8083' 'ai-sre-ops svc/executor 18090:8090'; do set -- $f; (while true; do kubectl -n $1 port-forward $2 $3 >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 2; done) & done; echo 'Prometheus :9090, Loki :3100, Kagent :18083, executor :18090 (Ctrl+C stops)'; wait
